title: Étale cohomology images of finite-coefficient derived retracts
statement:
Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and let $B$ be a finite discrete commutative ring, regarded as a condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Identify its pulled-back coefficient ring $B_X=p_X^*B$ with the constant ring on the small pro-étale site, and write $\nu_X:X_{\mathrm{proét}}\to X_{\mathrm{ét}}$ for the site comparison [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-pe-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Use module sheaves and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $C\in\Dctf(X,B)$ [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude], and let $J\xrightarrow{i}C\xrightarrow{r}J$ in the ambient derived category satisfy $ri=1_J$.

There exist $C_0\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{ét}},B)$ of finite Tor amplitude, an isomorphism $\nu_X^*C_0\simeq C$, and, for every $q$, a unique idempotent $e_q$ on $H^q(C_0)$ whose image under exact $\nu_X^*$ is the endomorphism $H^q(i)H^q(r)$ under that isomorphism. Its image $I_q=\operatorname{im}(e_q)$ is a constructible étale $B$-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and
$$H^q(J)\simeq\nu_X^*I_q.$$
These sheaves are constructible in the pro-étale finite-constant-model sense. Every cohomological interval bounding $C$ also bounds $J$, and every Tor interval $[a,b]$ for $C$ is a Tor interval for $J$. In particular $J\in\Dctf(X,B)$.

proof.text: Choose the normalized finite discrete encoding E. Its proved encoding_constructibility theorem [lem-sf-finite-discrete-encoding-constructibility] transports bounded constructibility of C to fixed scalar module sheaves. On a qcqs scheme, ordinaryConstructible and the source IsConstructible predicate differ only by the universe size of the covering index: enlarge the small index by ULift in one direction and restrictIndexOfSmall in the other. Descend every constructible cohomology sheaf by [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-constructible-origin] and then the bounded complex by [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-bounded-constructible-origin]. This gives C0 and alpha without descent of J. Convert its etale constructibility by [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. Widen a chosen Tor interval to [min a b,b], transfer it by encoding_tensor_tor [lem-sf-finite-discrete-encoding-tensor-tor], and reflect it along alpha by the proved source fixed-module torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_iff underlying [lem-exc-comparison-tor-interval].

The canonical exact-functor homology isomorphism [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact] followed by homology of alpha identifies nu* Hq(C0) with Hq(E C). Set e to the preimage under the fully faithful sheaf comparison [det-pe-classical-sheaves-modules] of alpha_q.hom followed by Hq(r), Hq(i), alpha_q.inv. Faithfulness and i followed by r equal to identity prove e squared equals e. Cancelling alpha_q.hom and applying faithfulness proves uniqueness, even among all endomorphisms satisfying the commuting equation.

For an idempotent e, write s:V -> image(e) and k:image(e) -> V for the canonical image factorization. Cancel the epimorphism s in e squared equals e to obtain k followed by e equals k; cancel the monomorphism k to obtain k followed by s equals identity. Thus image(e) is a retract of V. The proved source IsConstructibleSheaf.of_retract, obtained as the kernel of the complementary idempotent by [thm-constructible-serre], makes image(e) constructible. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] in both directions to use precisely the finite-value convention of the statement.

Use explicit inverse maps Hq(i) alpha_q.inv nu*(s) and nu*(k) alpha_q.hom Hq(r). Functoriality, s followed by k equals e, k followed by s equals identity and the retraction equation prove both composites equal identity. This identifies Hq(E J) with nu* image(e), without requiring preservation of arbitrary images. The proved source isConstructible_comparisonUpperStar_obj (the forward direction of [lem-weil-pbc-fixed-module-constructible-origin]) gives constructibility on the same finite stratification; resizing cover indices gives ordinaryConstructible. Boundedness is stable under retracts, and [lem-sf-finite-discrete-encoding-constructibility] then transports bounded constructibility back to J, including each intrinsic cohomology sheaf.

Apply each homology functor to the retraction J -> C -> J. The first map is split monic, so if Hq(C) is zero then Hq(J) is zero. Apply the existing generic DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn and finiteTorAmplitude retract-stability instances, the direct-summand clauses recorded in [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude], to preserve every Tor interval and finite Tor amplitude. Combine the latter with bounded constructibility from the preceding step to conclude J belongs to Dctf.

lean.note: The normalized Encoding identifies the actual pulled-back condensed finite coefficient ring with the constant ring.
